## Purpose

Describe the concrete problem and the chosen solution.

## Validation

- [ ] PHP files lint successfully on PHP 8.1-compatible syntax.
- [ ] `php tests/static_validation.php` passes.
- [ ] Relevant runtime smoke tests pass.
- [ ] XLIFF placeholders and email variables remain unchanged.
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, order data, access links or production logs are included.
- [ ] Multistore, ownership, CSRF, idempotency and immutable-record controls are not weakened.

## Compatibility impact

List affected PrestaShop/PHP versions, themes, hooks, routes, database schema or upgrade requirements.
